title: Video: Octopath Traveler I & II Side-By-Side Graphics Comparison (Switch 1 & 2)
summary:
Spot the difference.

Following a surprise announcement in July, Square Enix has officially released Octopath Traveler and Octopath Traveler 2 on the Switch 2 this week. If you are wondering how the HD-2D RPG series looks on Nintendo's new hybrid system compared to the old one, side-by-side graphics comparison videos are now being uploaded online.

There are also improved load times when launching the game and save files.
